work: The Book of Common Prayer: A Catechism and The Form of Solemnization of Matrimon
heading: The Form of Solemnization of MATRIMONY.

items.text: Love her as Christ loved the church and gave himself for her.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: Husbands, love your Wives, even as Christ also loved the Church, and gave himself for it

items.text: Nourish and cherish her as your own flesh.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: no man ever yet hateth his own flesh, but nourisheth and cherisheth it

items.text: Be not bitter against her.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them

items.text: Dwell with her according to knowledge, giving honor to her as to the weaker vessel.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: dwell with your wives according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel

items.text: Leave your father and mother and be joined to your wife; the two shall become one flesh.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joyned unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh

items.text: Submit yourself to your own husband as to the Lord.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: Wives, submit your selves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord

items.text: Reverence your husband.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: Let the wife see that she reverence her husband

items.text: Be loving and amiable, faithful and obedient to him.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: this Woman may be loving and amiable, faithful and obedient to her Husband

items.text: Be in subjection to your own husband, adorned with a meek and quiet spirit rather than outward ornaments.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: be in subjection to your own husbands... even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit

items.text: Bring up your children Christianly and virtuously to God's praise and honor.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: they may see their children Christianly and virtuously brought up to thy praise and honour

work: The Book of Common Prayer: A Catechism and The Form of Solemnization of Matrimon
heading: A CATECHISM, that is to say, An Instruction to be learned of every Person, before he be brought to be Confirmed by the Bishop.

items.text: Love, honor, and succor your father and mother.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, Catechism
items.quote: To love, honour, and succour my father and mother.

items.text: On the Sabbath, let your son and daughter do no work.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, Catechism
items.quote: In it thou shalt do no manner of work, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter.

work: The Book of Common Prayer: A Catechism and The Form of Solemnization of Matrimon
heading: A CATECHISM, that is to say, An Instruction to be learned of every Person, before he be brought to be Confirmed by the Bishop.

items.text: Send your children to the church for catechetical instruction and require them to hear and obey the curate until they have learned the catechism.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, A Catechism
items.quote: Fathers, Mothers... shall cause their Children... to come to the Church at the time appointed, and obediently to hear

items.text: Require your servants and apprentices to attend catechetical instruction in church until they have learned the catechism.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, A Catechism
items.quote: Masters and Dames, shall cause their... Servants... to come to the Church at the time appointed, and obediently to hear

work: The Book of Common Prayer: A Catechism and The Form of Solemnization of Matrimon
heading: The Form of Solemnization of MATRIMONY.

items.text: Love her, comfort her, honour and keep her in sickness and in health, forsaking all other, and keep thee only unto her, so long as ye both shall live.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: love her, comfort her, honour and keep her in sickness and in health, and forsaking all other, keep thee only unto her

items.text: Love, honour and keep him in sickness and in health, forsaking all other, and keep thee only unto him, so long as ye both shall live.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: love, honour and keep him in sickness and in health, and forsaking all other, keep thee only unto him

items.text: Obey him and serve him.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: obey him, serve him

items.text: Endow her with all your worldly goods.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: with all my worldly goods I thee endow

items.text: Bring up your children in the fear and nurture of the Lord, to the praise of his holy Name.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: for the procreation of Children, to be brought up in the fear and nurture of the Lord

items.text: Provide mutual society, help and comfort to one another, both in prosperity and adversity.
items.citation: Book of Common Prayer, The Form of Solemnization of Matrimony
items.quote: mutual society, help and comfort that the one ought to have of the other, both in prosperity and adversity
